name: What preparation is needed before Frasheski Construction arrives to install my new cabinets or vanity?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before Frasheski Construction arrives to install my new cabinets or vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation, clear the work area of personal items, breakable objects, and any furniture that might obstruct access. For vanity installations, ensure plumbing access is clear. If existing cabinets or vanities are being removed, decide if you'd like us to handle the demolition and disposal, or if you prefer to do it yourself to save on labor costs. Having a clear understanding of your desired layout and any special requirements, like electrical outlets inside cabinets, will also help streamline the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the work area, ensure plumbing access for vanities, and decide on demolition. Having your layout and special requirements ready streamlines the process.
